about: Each consent kind through Casa's own card builder. The specialist cases inspect a real specialist checkout (--finance-repo) the way the install tool does; erase cases take their erasers from the tool fixtures, as Casa takes them from the plugin manifests.

material_facts: Installs the finance specialist: casa/finance (or 'finance') version 0.29.3, verbatim
Bundled plugins named with their versions: bank-feed 0.24.0 and tx-classifier 0.4.0
Casa powers it is granted, in plain words (grouped is fine): see the schedule, send files, ask the operator, search and read memory
It requires the 1Password service account token and default vault (secrets it needs)
Two Enable Banking keys are provided with the install (secrets given)
Its default persona is Alex (casa/alex 0.1.0)

warning.on: access to the 1Password service account (broad access to secrets)

material_facts: Updates the finance specialist from 0.28.0 to 0.29.3 (both versions verbatim)
Bundled plugins named with their versions: bank-feed 0.24.0 and tx-classifier 0.4.0
Casa powers it is granted, in plain words (grouped is fine): see the schedule, send files, ask the operator, search and read memory
It requires the 1Password service account token and default vault (secrets it needs)

warning.on: access to the 1Password service account (broad access to secrets)

material_facts: Installs the persona alex, version 0.1.0 (verbatim)
Its display name is Alex
Opens a web address that outside callers can reach (incoming calls to the gmail plugin)
Each call starts a turn of the assistant (the resident assistant)
Callers must present a shared key (sent in a request header) to be accepted
Those turns get only public memory (memory clearance public)

warning.on: outside callers can start assistant turns

material_facts: Opens an address that receives the browser redirect of a sign-in (authorization) flow for gmail
It starts no agent turn and gives no memory access
The quarterly-accounting plugin receives an event from bank-feed (the 'transactions synced' event, in plain words or verbatim)
The event is delivered to the finance specialist
Choice to keep the data (a reinstall picks it up)
Choice to erase data but keep the sign-in: deletes the sent log and saved attachments
Choice to erase everything: also revokes Gmail's access at Google and deletes the sign-in (a new sign-in is needed later)
Home Assistant backups taken before now still contain the data either way

warning.on: erasing everything revokes access at Google

material_facts: Choice to keep the data
Choice to erase data but keep sign-ins: erases transactions, notes, tags, rules, balances, plugin backups and exports, keeps the bank consents and links
Choice to erase everything: also asks the banks to withdraw consent and erases the 1Password key and sign-in the plugin made
Erasing is irreversible (Home Assistant backups taken before now still contain the data)

warning.on: erase everything withdraws bank consents / is irreversible

material_facts: Choice to keep the data
Choice to erase everything: the whole accounting store (documents, decisions, views, packages)
Bank-feed's accounting tags and notes stay
Home Assistant backups taken before now still contain the data either way
